Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent game character costume atlas, NOT a mockup. Supporting style reference: supplied Feudalism board and lineup; keep their bright charming hand-painted 2.5D cartoon aesthetic, readable expressive faces, broad silhouettes, gold accents, simplified shaded forms. Create NEW culturally and personally distinct identities specified below, not copies of the blue swordsman. Actual alpha transparent background, absolutely no text, labels, grid lines, scenery, ground, shadows or equipment. Each cell contains ONE complete STANDING human, three-quarter facing RIGHT, fully visible top of head to soles, empty half-open hands held near waist ready for modular equipment. NO held weapons, NO shields, NO horses even for cavalry (mounted gear may be riding boots). Do not draw any sword, staff or bow. All bodies share game proportions about three heads tall, clean uncluttered lines. Same scale across grid. Inside EACH equal square cell: feet centered x50% at y88%, head near y13%; front right hand at x64%y60%, off handx34%y59%; every opaque part strictly within x17..83%,y10..89%. Wide fully transparent gutters between figures, no silhouette can touch or cross its cell. Faces visibly distinct; honor named rank, region and actual armor, don't turn all warriors into Western knights. Output ONLY the atlas.

7. Selena: olive-skinned Byzantine-inspired woman, dark curly bob, perceptive wide brown eyes, saffron and plum light travel tunic, no helmet.
8. Sieg: lean Japanese man, sharp eyes, straight black hair tied back, deep navy and red shinobi travel cloth, no mask, no helmet.
